    StartersBubba's barbecue prawnsSkewered prawns brushed with smoked paprika garlic butter, lemon to squeezeHow to make it600g green prawns60g butter2 garlic cloves1 tsp smoked paprika1 pinch cayenne pepper1 lemonPeel the prawns and thread onto skewers.Melt the butter with crushed garlic, paprika and cayenne and brush over.Grill, turning once, and squeeze lemon over.MainsBubba's prawn gumboDark roux gumbo with smoked sausage, vegetables and prawnsHow to make it80ml vegetable oil80g plain flour1 brown onion2 celery sticks1 green capsicum2 garlic cloves1 L chicken stock250g smoked sausage500g green prawns300g long grain riceStir the oil and flour over medium heat into a dark roux.Dice the onion, celery and capsicum and slice the sausage. Peel the prawns.Add the vegetables and garlic to the roux, then the stock and sausage. Simmer.Cook the rice.Add the prawns to the gumbo for the last few minutes and serve over the rice.Greenbow buttermilk fried chickenHome cooking in Greenbow, AlabamaHow to make itAs written, serves 4Chicken pieces brined overnight in buttermilk and hot sauce, dredged in spiced flour, fried crunchy, with garlicky greens and buttery mash.Soak 1.5kg chicken pieces overnight in 500ml buttermilk with 2 tbsp hot sauce and 2 tsp salt.Mix 300g plain flour with 2 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp pepper and salt.Dredge the chicken and fry at 165°C for 12 to 15 minutes until 74°C inside.Mash 1kg potatoes with 80g butter.Saute 2 bunches silverbeet or kale with garlic and a splash of vinegar.SweetsPeach cobblerCinnamon peaches under a soft biscuit topping, with vanilla ice creamHow to make it6 peaches80g caster sugar1 tsp cinnamon80g butter200g self-raising flour150ml full cream milk1 L vanilla ice creamSlice the peaches and toss with the sugar and cinnamon in a dish.Rub the butter into the flour, add the milk and drop spoonfuls over the fruit.Bake at 190°C.Serve with vanilla ice cream.Forrest's chocolatesHandmade dark chocolates filled with caramel, raspberry ganache or peanut butterHow to make it250g dark chocolate100g caramels100ml thickened cream50g raspberries80g peanut butterMelt the chocolate and paint it into chocolate moulds. Set.Fill some moulds with caramel melted with a little cream, some with raspberry ganache and some with peanut butter.Seal with more chocolate and set.Pack them in a box and mix them up.DrinksWhite House cherry vanilla sodaCherry and vanilla syrup over ice, topped up with sodaHow to make it300g frozen pitted cherries150g caster sugar150ml water1 vanilla bean1 lime800ml soda waterice, to serveSimmer the cherries with the sugar, water and split vanilla bean.Mash, strain and cool the syrup.Fill four tall glasses with ice and add syrup and a squeeze of lime to each.Top with cold soda water, stir, and finish with a cherry.
